attributes.text:
Green Street Australia
Private Market Data is Live
Now live – access to Green Street's Australia Private Market Research, Data and Sales Comps.

• Coverage across industrial, office, and retail for ‘B/B+’ quality assets spanning Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, and Adelaide, plus ‘A/A+’ quality insight.
  • Three sector outlook reports covering macro trends, operating fundamentals, and key valuation insights. 
  • Deeper supply and demand analysis with statistically back-tested market grading framework behind long-term growth rates, supporting terminal value underwriting. 
  • IRRs enabling relative return comparisons across markets in Australia and globally, on an apples-to-apples basis.
  • Forecasting model outputs with two decades of history with various underwriting metrics including headline market rent, M-RevPAM, like-for-like NOI growth, net initial yield indexes and commercial property price indexes.
  • Real-time and extensive sales comps, analyst-verified with price, location, size, and the buyer, seller, and broker details.
Access your way: In-platform, Excel Add-In, API, Snowflake or MCP Server Connection.
Book a walkthrough with Customer Success

Disclosure: To see Green Street’s disclosure in its entirety, please click here. Emails sent to and from Green Street are subject to review and archiving by Green Street. While Green Street offers certain regulated products and services, our global Research, Data and Analytics products, global News publications, and client-facing AI tools are not provided in our capacity as an investment advisor or fiduciary, and such products and services do not constitute investment advice. The Green Street Forecasting tool is an estimation of future events based on market trends in historical data that have proved to provide actionable insights during past market cycles. Green Street makes no representations or warranties as to any future performance of such metrics under any market cycles.
